scope: native volume source adapter and live capability probe
qualified_behavior: The worker source adapter revalidates volume mount point and opaque identity before and after traversal.
POSIX source traversal uses native handles, refuses mount-boundary traversal, preserves sparse extents, and records explicit loss records.
Live capability probing is read-only and does not request elevation or unmount a volume.
Windows retains exact UTF-16 mount units, probes native readability, and revalidates those units before traversal.
The archive path codec does not use display UTF-8 as a substitute for native Windows names.
not_yet_qualified: Production snapshot-provider and real-volume acceptance qualification
